response.original_title: [Complete-Guide] Can You Add a Passenger to Freedom of the Seas?
response.overview: Yes, you can add a passenger to an existing Royal Caribbean Freedom of the Seas booking +1-866-254-7549, but it cannot be done online or through the mobile app. How to Add a Passenger Call Customer Service: Dial Royal Caribbean directly +1-866-254-7549 or contact your travel advisor to process the change manually. Third-Party Bookings: If you booked through a travel agency +1-866-254-7549 or online vendor, you must ask them to make the modification for you +1-866-254-7549.Important Rules & Limits Stateroom Capacity: Your current cabin must have physical space for an extra person, such as a pull-out sofa or Pullman bed. Ship Capacity: The total number of people on the ship must remain under legal safety and lifeboat limits +1-866-254-7549. Room Upgrades: If your current cabin is at maximum capacity, you may need to upgrade to a larger room category.
